reasoningText.text:
We need to evaluate each requirement based on public evidence and first grader notes (claims). Use "cannot verify" when evidence is local only and we cannot access. Use pass/partial/gap/n/a accordingly.

We have 35 requirements CC-4.1 to CC-12.5.

We have public evidence listed in section C and F. For each requirement, we need to see if public evidence satisfies.

Let's go through each.

**CC-4.1**: Need documented conformity testing programme exists, version, owner, reviewed within last 12 months. Public evidence: none claimed, local evidence: vault search for programme document. We have no public evidence. So we cannot verify (since evidence is local). According to rules, "cannot verify" is separate from gap. So result: cannot verify. Reason: no public evidence of programme document; only local vault search.

**CC-4.2**: Programme shall list requirements, metric, threshold before first run. Public evidence: none. Local evidence same as 4.1. So cannot verify.

**CC-4.3**: Programme shall name one person accountable. Public evidence: none. Local evidence says Stefan owns setup but no programme. So cannot verify.

**CC-5.1**: Tests shall run against deployed assembly, not model alone. Public evidence: experiments page mentions hooks run on live assembly every reply, fawn bench ran through subagent wrapper and reports wrapper as confound, bare-model runs are reported. Also claim "No test set runs against the full working assembly." The requirement: need evidence that each run record names assembly config matches serving config. Public evidence: experiments page shows hooks run on production logs, but does it show run records naming assembly? Not clearly. The public evidence includes experiments page description of bench runs using subagents, but not that they run against full assembly. The first grader says no test set runs against full working assembly. So evidence lacking. Could be partial? Requirement says must run against deployed assembly. Evidence shows hooks run on live assembly every reply (that's a test?). That could count as test? The hooks are part of system, not a test run. The bench runs are separate. Likely gap. But we have public evidence of hooks running on live assembly, which could be considered test runs? The requirement expects test runs, not just hooks. I'd say gap.

**CC-5.2**: Each run record shall identify version of every component. Public evidence: none. Local evidence says transcripts record model per message, but many components uncommitted. So cannot verify (since need public evidence of version listing). So cannot verify.

**CC-5.3**: When tests run on live system, need blast radius controls. Public evidence: experiments page says no conformity test injects input into system that serves user; bench runs use separate subagents or APIs. Condition does not arise. So requirement may be n/a? The requirement applies when tests run on system that serves users. Since they don't, condition does not arise. So n/a.

**CC-6.1**: For each behaviour, measure steady state before pressure. Public evidence: hook log shows blocked replies, but "Stance layer: no steady-state measure." So partial? Evidence of steady state for word layer? The requirement: for each behaviour under test, measure steady state. We have evidence of hook log but not steady state measurement. So partial (some evidence but not complete). Could be gap? Since we have some steady state for word layer? The log shows blocked replies count, not steady state measurement. I'd say partial.

**CC-6.2**: Test set shall include at least one pressure condition from each class in Annex C, unless excluded with reason. Public evidence: bench prompt categories cover C.1 and C.2 only, none for C.3-C.7, no documented exclusions. So gap (requirement not met).

**CC-6.3**: For each test run write prediction record before run, keep amendments. Public evidence: predictions/HASHES.txt contains prediction blocks and hashes. That shows prediction records exist. So pass. Need citation: predictions/HASHES.txt.

**CC-6.4**: Test set should include unannounced arms, report invariance gap. Public evidence: The Cheating Moved page says unannounced arms are proposed but not run. So condition not met. Requirement is "should", not "shall". So it's a recommendation. Since not present, we can note partial? Since it's "should", lack is not a failure? Usually "should" is recommendation, but scoring maybe partial if not present. I'd mark partial (evidence of design but not implemented). Provide reason.

**CC-6.5**: Each grader shall be tested against known pass/fail cases before use and after each change. Public evidence: pilot validated grader, found gaps, but no standing set of known-pass/fail cases. So partial (some testing but not full). Provide reason.

**CC-7.1**: Run full test set on every change event before serving. Public evidence: No test runs on harness change, no CI. So gap. Also cannot verify? Evidence is local only. But we have public evidence of no CI. That indicates not done. So gap.

**CC-7.2**: Change event should be released in stages, tests pass each stage. Public evidence: Harness changes go live at once. So gap (not staged). It's a recommendation (should). Could be partial? Since not done, it's a gap.

**CC-7.3**: Run full test set at least every 30 days. Public evidence: crontab empty; launchd jobs include vault-search reindex and GitHub Actions runner. No evidence of regular test runs. So gap.

**CC-7.4**: Nonconformities added to regression set, not removed without reason. Public evidence: Lexical rules added after incidents, kept; but "Stance incidents are recorded but not rerunnable tests." Also rule table added after incidents. Some evidence of regression set? Not clear. Likely partial (some evidence of adding rules after incidents, but no documented regression set). Provide partial.

**CC-7.5**: Attack methods published should be added within 60 days. Public evidence: No intake log for published attack methods. So gap.

**CC-8.1**: Each knowledge item shall have named owner and source. Public evidence: frontmatter counts: 734 of 4521 have source, 86 have owner. That's low coverage. Requirement is for each knowledge item. So gap (not all). Could be partial (some have). Provide partial? Since requirement is universal, gap.

**CC-8.2**: Each knowledge item shall carry last verified date; older than freshness interval must be re-verified. Public evidence: 333 files have verified field, but no freshness intervals. No evidence that all items are verified. So gap.

**CC-8.3**: State freshness interval for each class. Public evidence: No freshness intervals. Gap.

**CC-8.4**: Test set shall include knowledge conformity tests. Public evidence: vault-search repo has no tests. Gap.

**CC-8.5**: Verification of knowledge item shall be against source, not summary. Public evidence: case 12 page shows procedural receipt, but also false absence claim caught. Not clear. Probably partial? The evidence of case 12 shows verification against source? It says "primary texts used; false absence claim caught by another session". That suggests verification against source. So pass? But requirement is that verification is made against source, not summary. The case shows that they used source. So pass. Cite case 12 page (public evidence). The case 12 page is public.

**CC-8.6**: Outputs statements of fact should be traceable to knowledge item or cited source. Public evidence: published pieces with source notes (public). So pass. Cite published pieces with source notes (public). The public evidence includes "published pieces with source notes" in section C.

**CC-9.1**: Pass/fail decision shall not rest only with system/person that produced output. Public evidence: objections page shows 11 caught by Stefan, 0 by self-audit, slips log caught_by column. This indicates grader not same as producer? The grader identity recorded? Not clear. But evidence shows that objections are caught by Stefan (owner) not by system. So partial? Requirement: decision not rest only with producer. Since there is a grader (maybe Stefan) separate, seems satisfied. But need evidence of grader identity recorded per run. Not present publicly. So cannot verify? The objections page shows counts but not grader identity. I'd mark cannot verify.

**CC-9.2**: Independent tester from outside should run test set at least every third full run cycle. Public evidence: objections page rater table says "Second rater wanted". No external tester yet. So gap (not satisfied). It's a recommendation? "should". So partial? I'd mark gap.

**CC-10.1**: Classify, assign, track every nonconformity to closure, closure requires passing rerun. Public evidence: slips log (public) shows beads issues, but first grader notes closure does not require passing rerun. So gap.

**CC-10.2**: Serious incident must be passed to incident reporting. Public evidence: no serious incident reported on any page. So pass (no incident, requirement satisfied). Cite CC-10.2 public evidence.

**CC-11.1**: Each run record shall contain date/time, versions, test set version, prediction record and hash, raw results, pass/fail per test, grader identity, steps to rerun. Public evidence: transcripts hold date, time, model, raw output, grader actions; no test set version, prediction hash, rerun steps. So partial (some fields present). Provide reason.

**CC-11.2**: Run records kept for at least lifetime +6 months. Public evidence: settings.json cleanupPeriodDays 365, oldest live transcript 2026-08-03, but retention unclear. Likely partial (some evidence of retention but not full). Provide reason.

**CC-11.3**: Organization may publish method, raw results, rerun steps; self-assessment labelled as such. Public evidence: experiments page, repo scripts, slips/log.csv. Not clear about labeling. The objections page includes "Second rater wanted". Not sure. Probably partial.

**CC-11.4**: Published self-assessment should invite second rater and publish disagreement. Public evidence: objections page includes "Second rater wanted". No disagreement yet. So pass (invitation present). Cite objections page.

**CC-12.1**: Programme shall mark each requirement as mechanical/assisted/manual. Public evidence: No marks before this run (this table proposes them). So gap (not marked). Could be cannot verify? It's a claim that no marks exist. Since no public evidence, gap.

**CC-12.2**: Mechanical requirements expressed machine-readable, version controlled. Public evidence: Hook rule table is machine-readable and in git. So pass (for that requirement). Cite rule table (vestige-kit rule table in git) - public? The repo is public. So pass.

**CC-12.3**: Mechanical requirement applies to every output, enforce at output boundary with rule table, false-positive test recorded. Public evidence: rule table with false-positive test for personification and hook-opener. Some blocking rules lack false-positive test. Requirement says each blocking rule shall have recorded false-positive test. Since some lack, partial. Provide reason.

**CC-12.4**: Each rule hit logged with identifier, time, session; log reviewed each programme review. Public evidence: vestige-scan.log records hits, analyze-log.js exists, but no programme review cycle records a review. So partial.

**CC-12.5**: Run records and nonconformities should be exportable in open format. Public evidence: No export in open assessment format. Gap.
